goal: Audit the current Body War OEW interface for contrast, readability, and navigation, then return verified change requests plus a reusable candidate post-update audit protocol without editing the interface or ontology.
context: P1 applies on synthesis, isolation, parallelism, and context protection because three independent whole-interface lenses and opposed verification must reconcile browser, source, and evidence-boundary observations. The exact target is the current Body War OEW loopback browser artifact, its admitted graph and receipts, and the existing focus-scene UX/validation design; browser attackers begin black-box and freeze initial observations before source inspection. The audit must test the current all-node black box, control purpose, bounded context clusters and portals, Path behavior, category icons, and one stable color per exact sourcePredicate with non-color redundancy; it may produce change requests and a candidate reuse protocol but no UI, ontology, generated-run, promotion, release, deployment, or human-comprehension claim. Inventory supplied prior Body War black-box and novice-comprehension results plus cross-project interface/readability precedents, while the current target and every surviving finding still require fresh literal verification.
anti_bias_global: visual compliance versus reading economy versus navigational structure, all bounded by semantic and human-evidence honesty

groups.anti_bias: methodology (computational contrast and non-color measurement vs empirical task and reading analysis vs formal navigation-state analysis)

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 may require persistent labels and redundant visual cues for non-color recovery even when they add density, while agent 1 may reject the same cues as reading noise and prefer fewer simultaneously visible explanations; each exposes the other's accessibility-versus-economy blind spot on the methodology axis.

Agent 0 may accept a control or edge language once measured contrast, focus, and non-color cues pass, while agent 2 may reject it because scope, Back, portal, or Path state remains structurally ambiguous; each exposes the other's local-presentation-versus-navigation blind spot on the methodology axis.

Agent 1 may accept the shortest search-led task path as readable and efficient, while agent 2 may reject it for failing to build a recoverable context-and-relation model; conversely agent 2 may favor clusters and portals that agent 1 finds add unnecessary steps and terminology on the methodology axis.

agents.angle: computational contrast, focus visibility, categorical color consistency, grayscale and forced-colors recovery, keyboard equivalence, and reduced-motion state parity
agents.initial_prompt: Attack the whole current Body War OEW interface using the contrast_and_non_color lane from strategy-inventory-packet.json and the frozen SCENARIO.md. Begin black-box in a fresh browser context and freeze initial observations before reading application source. Measure relevant text and component contrast before recommending exact tokens; inspect default, selected, portal, Path, grayscale, forced-colors where supported, keyboard-only, reduced-motion, desktop, and narrow states. Test that one exact sourcePredicate such as owns or depends_on uses one stable color across scenes, never one arbitrary color per edge instance, while visible predicate text, line pattern, marker/direction text, category text, focus, status, and authority remain recoverable without color. Use the prior Body War black-box Inventory entry only to select regression targets, never as current proof. Return exact observation, evidence class, severity, one-line repair, deterministic assertion, screenshot/measurement locator, human-evidence ceiling, and a zero-finding attack ledger if needed. Do not edit files or persist the runtime token. Budget about 2600 tokens.

agents.angle: empirical cold-reader task flow, information scent, copy hierarchy, card density, terminology, wrong turns, and locate/trace/retell/distinguish/boundary/vocabulary evidence

groups.anti_bias: attack-vector (counter-example and proxy-gaming falsification vs definitional, scope, and semantic-authority falsification)

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 may drop a change because scripted search, labels, or screenshots make its acceptance assertion non-discriminating while agent 1 keeps the observable defect but rejects its proposed cluster, Path, color, or icon repair for inventing semantic or authority meaning; each exposes a distinct false-positive mode on the attack-vector axis.
